column8: {Root : Type} → {scheme : Minidregg.Theory.CausalVersionDag.ContentAddressing} → (materializer : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentEventLog.Sparse.Materializer Root) → Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentEventLog.Sparse.Cell materializer → Minidregg.Theory.Hyperdocument.StoredVersionEvent scheme → Prop := fun {Root} {scheme} materializer pre event => Minidregg.Theory.CellState.ValidatedPatch materializer pre (Minidregg.Theory.CellState.Materialized.root pre) [Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentEventLog.Sparse.appendOp event]

∀ {Root : Type} {scheme : Minidregg.Theory.CausalVersionDag.ContentAddressing} {materializer : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentEventLog.Sparse.Materializer Root} {pre : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentEventLog.Sparse.Cell materializer} {event : Minidregg.Theory.Hyperdocument.StoredVersionEvent scheme} (accepted : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentEventLog.Sparse.AcceptedAppend materializer pre event), Minidregg.Kernel.SparseAuthenticatedState.Trace.BusRelation 0 pre.logical [Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentEventLog.Sparse.appendOp event] (Minidregg.Kernel.SparseAuthenticatedState.Trace.busRows pre.logical [Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentEventLog.Sparse.appendOp event]) (Minidregg.Theory.CellState.ValidatedPatch.apply accepted).logical

∀ {Root : Type} {scheme : Minidregg.Theory.CausalVersionDag.ContentAddressing} {materializer : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentEventLog.Sparse.Materializer Root} {pre : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentEventLog.Sparse.Cell materializer} {event : Minidregg.Theory.Hyperdocument.StoredVersionEvent scheme} (accepted : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentEventLog.Sparse.AcceptedAppend materializer pre event), ¬Minidregg.Theory.Store.Op.Enabled (Minidregg.Theory.CellState.ValidatedPatch.apply accepted).logical (Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentEventLog.Sparse.appendOp event)

∀ {Root : Type} {scheme : Minidregg.Theory.CausalVersionDag.ContentAddressing} {materializer : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentEventLog.Sparse.Materializer Root} {pre : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentEventLog.Sparse.Cell materializer} {event : Minidregg.Theory.Hyperdocument.StoredVersionEvent scheme} (accepted : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentEventLog.Sparse.AcceptedAppend materializer pre event), (Minidregg.Theory.CellState.ValidatedPatch.apply accepted).logical (Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentEventLog.Sparse.eventAddress event.key) = Option.some event.record

∀ {Root : Type} {scheme : Minidregg.Theory.CausalVersionDag.ContentAddressing} {materializer : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentEventLog.Sparse.Materializer Root} {pre : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentEventLog.Sparse.Cell materializer} {event : Minidregg.Theory.Hyperdocument.StoredVersionEvent scheme}, Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentEventLog.Sparse.AcceptedAppend materializer pre event → pre.logical (Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentEventLog.Sparse.eventAddress event.key) = Option.none

∀ {Root : Type} [DecidableEq Root] {scheme : Minidregg.Theory.CausalVersionDag.ContentAddressing} {materializer : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentEventLog.Sparse.Materializer Root} {pre : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentEventLog.Sparse.Cell materializer} (event : Minidregg.Theory.Hyperdocument.StoredVersionEvent scheme), pre.logical (Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentEventLog.Sparse.eventAddress event.key) = Option.none → Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentEventLog.Sparse.AcceptedAppend materializer pre event

∀ {scheme : Minidregg.Theory.CausalVersionDag.ContentAddressing} (store : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentEventLog.Sparse.Store) (event : Minidregg.Theory.Hyperdocument.StoredVersionEvent scheme), Minidregg.Theory.Store.Op.Enabled store (Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentEventLog.Sparse.appendOp event) ↔ store (Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentEventLog.Sparse.eventAddress event.key) = Option.none
